reviews.title: Good deal for reasonable to good graphics
reviews.comment: Extremely good for the price range. Getting 60-80fps on high demand games on high and a couple settings on ultra. Get 180-200fps on less demanding games. Not a crazy graphics card, but very very solid for the price.
reviews.author: Aidan Mcnutt

reviews.title: Good results with Premiere Pro
reviews.comment: Solid results in HP G4 Z4 workstation used for Adobe Premiere editing with three 4K monitors. I was surprised that rendering to MP4s does not seem to be a lot faster over the P2000 card it replaced.
reviews.author: Andrew Mellows

reviews.title: Great card! Compatible with my MSI MAG B850M WiFi motherboard
reviews.comment:
Great card! Compatible with my MSI MAG B850M WiFi motherboard. Smaller size than some cards.
Very low noise level, most of the time the fan is not even running.
GREAT PRICE too!
reviews.author: Big Daddy

reviews.title: Great
reviews.comment: Card works better than previous card installed. No issues with this card whatsoever. Easy installation, great graphics.
reviews.author: Sarah Rodriguez
